Sahyadri Cancer Institute (SYNTHETIC)
Department of Radiology
CECT THORAX REPORT
Patient SYNTHETIC, Ramesh Kumar
UHID SYN-100231
Age / Sex 62 Y / M
Study date 28-Aug-2026
Comparison CT thorax 10-Nov-2025
Findings
Spiculated mass in the right upper lobe measuring 5.2 x 4.1 cm, previously 2.1 cm on CT
dated 10-Nov-2025.
Enlarged right hilar lymph node, 1.8 cm short axis. Subcarinal (station 7) node 1.6 cm. Right
lower paratracheal (4R) node 1.2 cm.
No pleural effusion. Adrenal glands normal. No lytic or sclerotic bone lesion in the imaged
skeleton.
Impression (reporting radiologist)
Right upper lobe mass with interval increase in size; ipsilateral hilar and mediastinal
lymphadenopathy.
Report status: FINAL
Reported by: Dr. Arjun Rao, Consultant Radiologist (electronically signed)
Signed: 28-Aug-2026 19:12
FINAL / SIGNED
SYNTHETIC -
DEMO ONLY
